|lore=Mos Eisley was built around wreckage of the colony ship ''Dowager Queen''. The wreck remains as a monument where residents leave junk for Jawa scavengers.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Dune Sea, Hutt Canyon, Jawa Camp, and Jawa Canyon are deserts. At deserts you occupy with a Jawa, Rontos and Sandcrawlers are power +1 and forfeit +2, and opponent’s Force generation is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)
